correctness.rationale: Each deterministic extreme direction produces the same full-set weight by a blockwise classical-parking bijection; the arbitrary time-dependent bias case follows by a convex sub-Markov kernel induction. The two-vacancy probabilities therefore have explicitly defined positive integer weights W. Conditional vacancy covariance equals (Z W_ij - H_i H_j)/Z^2. The standalone packaged program performs 342 exact assertions including independent direct enumeration, rational dynamic-programming comparisons, exhaustive strict sign checks for n=4..12, and the full 66-pair sign matrix at n=12. Smallest positive adjacent numerator at 12 is 581409157300000000; largest nonadjacent numerator is -3692131919133336000. No asymptotic extrapolation.

value.rationale: The natural two-vacancy almost-full street has competing effects: occupied sites cluster near each other under linear probing, yet fixed capacity induces negative global dependence. The smallest size at which all adjacent covariances become strictly positive, and the entire pairwise sign matrix there, are motivated spatial probability invariants. The exact finite first-occurrence cutoff is substantive without a claim for larger sizes.
